Configure Layer 2 Interfaces with No VLANs when you want Layer 2 switching and you don’t
need to separate traffic among VLANs.
STEP 1 |
Configure a Layer 2 interface.
1.
Select Network > Interfaces > Ethernet and select an interface. The Interface Name is
fixed, such as ethernet1/1.
2.
For Interface Type, select Layer2.
3.
Select the Config tab and assign the interface to a Security Zone or create a New Zone.
4.
Configure additional Layer 2 interfaces on the firewall that connect to other Layer 2
hosts.
STEP 2 |
Commit.
Click OK and Commit.
